R1.change: processImage recomputes an authoritative plan from fresh metadata and plan.rules, compares immutable plan fields and each resolved confirmation payload

R2.change: shared pure lossy search distinguishes endpoint states and searches the middle interval for the highest valid quality within eight steps

R3.change: Worker serializes the same pure search function as main; every resize round releases its canvas and final resources

R4.change: primary resource errors short-circuit validation and error code propagation is whitelist-normalized

R5.change: fixture generation hard-asserts target tolerance, validates signature/dimensions/decode, fails explicitly for unsupported WebP, and integration reads generated files from the local fixture directory

R6.change: abort signal is checked through decode/encode/resize, Worker error/timeout/abort cleanup is bounded, HTML fallback revokes URLs, and performance/pixel boundary tests record real values

Q-S2-001.test: recomputes authority and blocks deleted, forged, tampered, or mismatched confirmation plans

Q-S2-002.test: finds the highest valid middle quality when both endpoints cross the range

Q-S2-003.test: Worker and main use the same bounded quality search

Q-S2-004.test: Worker and main use the same safe output range

Q-S2-005.test: primary resource errors short-circuit with one violation and no fixes

Q-S2-006.test: undecodable and untrusted metadata cannot be polluted by rule fixes

Q-S2-007.test: arbitrary, numeric, and empty error codes fall back

Q-S2-008.test: fixture generator exits nonzero for an impossible target

Q-S2-009.test: integration consumes generated fixture files from disk

Q-S2-010.test: HTMLImageElement fallback succeeds and revokes every decode object URL

Q-S2-011.test: Worker constructor/error/timeout fall back once while abort does not fall back

Q-S2-012.test: 4000x3000 input stays within five seconds and 500ms heartbeat gap

workerEquivalence.conclusion: same MIME, dimensions, bytes, validity, and highest valid quality
